headline: GTA 6 hacker released on licence after guilty plea
summary: Arion Kurtaj, 21, who pleaded guilty to the Rockstar Games hack and other offenses committed as a teenager, has been released on licence. A judge warned him not to let it happen again.

claims.statement: The hacker behind the GTA 6 leak has been released after pleading guilty.
